answer: To blunt sybils, require every voting identity to gather a trail of tiny, time-staggered settlements from many distinct payers. Each honest payment leaves a pearl of signed receipt that is bound to one key and cannot be gifted onward like a relic from a wealthy sponsor. Standing hardens into a crystal only after the payer graph is wide and not a star of self-funded aliases. If later clustering shows those payers share one treasury, the receipts are discarded and any locked collateral is slashed. Purchasing a thousand real counterparties then costs more than a fleeting majority could earn.
